parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the door and base, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom part of the cabinet, made of MDF, providing stability and support for the structure.
parts.Functional_description: It distributes the cabinet’s weight evenly and ensures it stands level on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is the front panel made of solid wood, attached to the frame with hinges and equipped with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior by opening and closing, protecting stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.
